## 主张 Claim

共同工作与认可形成参与资格，实际提案经既有授权程序改变后续筛选规则；分化或交接携带该规则，实际继续参与决定其执行，继承的差异改变后续可进入的决策。 / Reviewed work and recognition form mandates; an actual proposal changes the later filtering rule through the existing authorization procedure. Branching or handoff carries that rule, continuing participation determines execution, and inherited differences change subsequent admitted decisions.

Canonical source: [OrganizationalRuleInheritance.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/OrganizationalRuleInheritance.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 种子授权、认可及复制能力、提案内容、参与和遵守程序给定；更高层修订程序固定。 / Seed mandate, recognition/copying capacity, proposal content, participation and procedural compliance are supplied; the higher amendment procedure is fixed.
- 多数票以完整登记名册为分母；两人后备路径有十四天输入与无反对条件，不模拟真实时钟、共识或执行软件。 / Majority uses the full recorded roster; the two-support fallback has a fourteen-day input and no-opposition condition. No real clock, consensus process or software execution is simulated.
- 实际工作的执行、能力变化及持续参与的形成未闭合；被接受的决策数量不是工作后果。 / Work execution, capability change and the production of continued participation are not closed; admitted-decision counts are not work consequences.

社会接续从共同工作、资格和规则记录中分化；分支可共享参与者，记录继承不独自生成实际参与。Valkey及TDF原始材料提供有限机制对应，不是模型全程的实证复现。 整体与子系统是同一活动中的分化；该程序只表示其中一段关系，未形式化完整的相互反馈及边界变化。 解释以活动结果进入后续辨认与修订的具体关系、时序和参与变化为准；修复与学习可在同一活动中形成，不能由正式培训减少直接推出能力下降。 / Social continuations differentiate through work, mandates and retained rule histories. Branches can share participants, and inherited records do not create participation. Primary Valkey/TDF records support bounded mechanism correspondence, not empirical reproduction of the whole model. Whole and subsystems differentiate within the same activity; this protocol represents one connection, not formalized complete reciprocal feedback or changing boundaries. Exposition identifies how activity results enter later interpretation and revision, with changing order and participation. Repair and learning may form in one activity; fewer formal training sessions do not directly imply reduced capability.

## 检验与边界 Validation and boundaries

29项新定理／53项声明审计，81项实际导入闭包审计；原始记录审读与形式实查分开，无独立 agent 验收。 / 29 new theorems / 53 declaration audits, 81 audits in the actual import closure. Primary-record reading and formal checking remain separate; no independent-agent acceptance.

只证明条件性社会程序连接；未推出提案创造、最高授权起源、实际合法遵守、规则群体扩散优势或伦理正当性。 工作／能力／参与的反馈及子系统分化尚未接通；不能以程序链完成替代整体组织动力学完成。 / Only a conditional institutional connection is proved; proposal creativity, origin of highest authority, actual procedural compliance, population propagation advantage and ethical warrant remain unproved. Work/capability/participation feedback and subsystem differentiation remain unconnected; procedural completion is not completion of whole organizational dynamics.

- 复制规则而无人继续参与无法运作；仅两人时技术决策可执行而治理修订失败；重复投票、未到期限及反对保留失败。 / A copied rule without continuing participation cannot operate. Two participants may permit technical decisions while governance revision fails. Duplicate votes, inadequate time and opposition retain failure.
